description: Every check one transaction needs, in one call, on whatever you pass: the recipient screen (OFAC, Drain Watch, Tether and Circle freezes) on `to`, the USDT transfer simulation when `from` and `to` are both on Tron or both on Ethereum, the launch score on `tokenAddress`, and the signature decode on `calldata` or `typedData`. Answers ALLOW, WARN or BLOCK. BLOCK only on a fact that loses money; a low score alone is WARN.

amount.description: USDT amount, like 250; leave out to check the whole balance

calldata.description: Calldata or a JSON-RPC request to decode

chainId.description: Chain id or key (1, ethereum, base, tron, solana); read off the addresses when omitted

from.description: Sending address, for the USDT transfer simulation

tokenAddress.description: Token to score before buying or swapping

name: veriql_preflight
title: Veriql preflight (one call before send, swap or sign)
